price.note: Reported as roughly 800 rupees per month for a cheap service, suitable as per‑customer monthly revenue.
price.meaning: revenue per active customer per month

variable_cost.note: Assumed 30% of price for food ingredients, packaging, delivery and payment fees; conservative range reflects possible cost variations.
variable_cost.meaning: cost to serve one active customer per month (servicing, delivery, support, payment, insurance)

cac.note: Typical digital acquisition cost in Indian food‑delivery market; range covers lower digital ads spend to higher promotional offers.
cac.meaning: cost to acquire one paying customer

churn.note: Monthly churn for subscription‑style meal services in India usually 5‑10% based industry benchmarks.
churn.meaning: share of customers who cancel each month (0-1)

fixed_cost.note: Based on claim c200 of INR 60‑120k monthly rent for a commissary kitchen; includes rent, basic utilities and staff salaries for a single cloud kitchen.
fixed_cost.meaning: fixed operating cost per month (team, rent, software)

scenarios.name: Worst case
scenarios.how: every parameter at its unfavourable bound

scenarios.name: Best case
scenarios.how: every parameter at its favourable bound
